title: EntityProfileChangedPayload
description: Payload of the EntityProfileChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity whose profile changed.

changedAttributes.description: Each attribute that changed, old and new value as sent (opaque strings; consumers compare, not interpret).

oldValue.description: Value before the change, absent when the attribute was previously unset.

effectiveDate.description: Date the changed profile takes effect.
